# BAWARY.

> BAWARY. Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance Services — independent senior GxP QA consultancy
> for biopharmaceutical, CDMO, and API clients. Founder: Atiq Bawary, senior pharmaceutical
> QA professional (~15 years), former Senior QA Manager at Ardena (NL) and formally appointed
> QP Delegate at MSD/Merck (NL, 4 years). Based in Bedburg-Hau/Kleve, Germany (NRW),
> serving the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, and remote clients globally.

## Services
- [Batch release & QP-delegate support](https://bawary.github.io/#services): MBR/BPR review, release file compilation, raw material and intermediate release support
- [Deviation, OOS & CAPA management](https://bawary.github.io/#services): root-cause investigation leadership, risk-based CAPA, OOS/OOT/OOE laboratory review
- [EU GMP audit preparation](https://bawary.github.io/#services): gap assessments, mock inspections, Annex 1 / contamination control strategy (CCS) authoring
- [Vendor & CDMO auditing](https://bawary.github.io/#services): supplier qualification, CDMO/CMO audits, audit follow-up
- [Training & quality culture](https://bawary.github.io/#services): GxP, GDocP, deviation methodology training; inspection readiness

## Specialization
- Deviation Investigations and CAPA management 
- Experienced in the field of Biologics, Nano medicines, ADCs, and APIs in combination with Annex 1. 
- Bridge support for Asian and US sponsors preparing for EU GMP expectations, EU importers, and QP certification requirements
- On-site availability in the Netherlands, Germany (NRW), and Belgium within hours
